categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: Asphalt, Synthetic Resin, Chemical, and Others. The Asphalt segment involves manufacturing and selling asphalt and petroleum products, including waterproof sheets. The Synthetic Resin segment focuses on processing and selling PE, PP, and plastic products, including blow-molded bottles and pail containers. The Chemical segment supplies various petrochemical products such as organic solvents and inorganic compounds to diverse industries. The Others segment includes rental and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced asphalt processing technologies and manufacturing methods for waterproof sheets and plastic products, including extrusion and injection molding. It has proprietary technology for producing large-capacity blow-molded containers for precision chemical applications. The company also invests in eco-friendly product development and recycling technologies, such as high-purity solvent recycling facilities. Research and development focus on new materials, green growth road items, waterproofing systems, and asphalt concrete railway track technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction companies, manufacturers, large building projects, and civil engineering sectors for asphalt and waterproof sheets. Synthetic resin products serve domestic plastic manufacturers and petrochemical product distributors, with blow and pail products targeting construction, paint, surfactant, and chemical industries. Chemical products are supplied broadly across industries including electronics, film, adhesives, paint, cosmetics, and pharmaceuticals. The company also targets B2B markets for precision chemical packaging and eco-friendly construction materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with production facilities in Ulsan, Okcheon, Yangsan, Hwaseong, and Anseong. It maintains logistics hubs in Seoul, Busan, and Daegu. Export sales are made primarily to Asian countries, Oceania, Europe, America, and Africa, though domestic sales constitute about 81% of total revenue. The company also has overseas subsidiaries and business units in Malaysia, Hong Kong, and Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the petroleum and petrochemical supply chain. It manufactures and processes raw petroleum products into asphalt, synthetic resins, and chemical products, then distributes these to end-users in construction, manufacturing, and chemical industries. It also engages in recycling and eco-friendly product development, adding value within the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing competitive new materials and technologies, focusing on eco-friendly and green growth products aligned with government policies. R&D efforts target asphalt concrete railway track systems, environmentally friendly polyurethane additives, and advanced waterproofing materials. The company emphasizes innovation in recycling technologies and expanding precision chemical packaging markets. It also plans to enhance production efficiency and product quality through facility investments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of asphalt, synthetic resins, and chemical products. Sales channels include direct sales to end-users, distributors, and dealers, with a mix of cash and credit payment terms. The company also earns income from rental services and has begun generating revenue from cultural content ticket sales via online platforms. Export sales contribute a smaller portion of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds significant market shares in its core product lines, such as 72% in blown asphalt and 30% in waterproof sheets. It competes with domestic and international petrochemical and construction material manufacturers. Its competitive advantages include long-standing distributor relationships, proprietary technologies, diversified product portfolio, and alignment with ESG and green growth trends. Market competition is intense, especially in synthetic resin and chemical product segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 679 billion KRW, with operating profit of 15.2 billion KRW and net profit of 14.8 billion KRW. Total assets stood at about 354 billion KRW with a debt ratio of 99.57%, reflecting a solid financial structure. Although revenue decreased by 9.19% compared to the previous year, net profit increased by 34.18%, indicating improved profitability. The company has shown steady growth and maintains a strong capital base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable products tailored to customer needs, supported by strong technical support and after-sales service. It differentiates through proprietary technologies in blow molding and eco-friendly product development, including recycling and green construction materials. Its integrated service approach, including direct construction services and cultural content initiatives, enhances customer value. The company’s commitment to ESG and innovation positions it as a trusted partner in the petrochemical and construction materials markets.
